[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Salt Flats | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=114 }} [[Salt Flats]] is littered with the ruins of the ancient seafaring civilization as well as the remains of ancient massive beasts, judging by the size of the bones. == NPCs == === Allies === * {{x}} 15 [[Kelsay Pradist]] ([[collector]] for 5 [[Jade Mandible]]s) * {{x}} 10 [[Sir Norrington]] (collector for 5 [[Shriveled Eye]]s) * {{x}} 20 [[Sennat Sen]] ([[artisan]]) === Charmable animals === * {{x}} 5 [[Dune Lizard]] === Foes === [[Devourer]]s * {{r}} 20 (26) [[Rockshot Devourer]] [[Hydra]]s * {{e}} 22 (26) [[Hydra (Crystal Desert)]] [[Rider]]s * {{me}} 20 (26) [[Storm Kin]] [[Scarab]]s * {{n}} 20 (26) [[Jade Scarab]] * {{w}} 20 (26) [[Rock-Eater Scarab]] ==== Bosses ==== [[Devourer]]s * {{w}} 24 (30) [[Gralf Angonytip]] * {{r}} 24 (30) [[Ness Orangeclaw]] [[Hydra]]s * {{w}} 26 (30) [[Graf Wask Derg]] * {{r}} 26 (30) [[Brol Migo Hinga]] * {{mo}} 26 (30) [[Rept Parn Freg]] * {{n}} 26 (30) [[Jewk Swem Pleg]] * {{e}} 26 (30) [[Sheg Zamn Mada]] [[Rider]]s * {{mo}} 24 (30) [[Sul SandStorm]] * {{me}} 24 (30) [[Sevv Squallfroth]] * {{e}} 24 (30) [[Ginz Hailflare]] [[Scarab]]s * {{n}} 24 (30) [[Jonk Shuffle]] * {{me}} 24 (30) [[Vook Foomble]] == Landmarks == [[Statue of Glint]] == Notes == {{gw2w}} *These [[quest]]s will affect the [[spawn]]s in this area: ** [[The Ranger's Path]] ** [[A Belated Betrothal]] * Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.5% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. *{{Vanquisher|count = 200|low = 146|high = 255}} ** There are a lot of hidden foes littering the entire area, with hidden [[scarab]]s concentrated in the north, and hidden [[devourer]]s in the south. (Occasionally foes will spawn on the southern path to Skyward Reach, forcing you to trigger the southern popups.) ** It is sometimes possible to vanquish this area without killing all of the non-popup scarabs and devourers along the path to/from Skyward Reach. ** Many of the foes in this area, particularly the [[Storm Kin]] and [[Hydra]], travel quickly along long routes, making them easy to miss. Placing numerous spirits will help to slow or kill many of these [[patrol]]ling foes. *The northernmost [[Teleporter]] set is useless, due to you being able to walk on a narrow path up or down the cliff next to the left teleporter. == Trivia == * The fallen statue near the [[portal]] to Prophet's Path appears to be wearing a female's [[Warrior Templar armor|Templar helm]]. * This area has a high number of [[charmable animal]]s, possibly the highest in the game. {{Explorable areas in the Crystal Desert}} [[de:Salzebenen]]
